Params: {3: 'The metal hatch of the Tidal Hub groans and begins to buckle under heavy impacts.'}
{3: 'Sound ricochets between the steel beams, stirring up echoes that taste of rust.'}
{3: 'Deep in the corridors, alarms still blare in bursts. The crowd flooding into the Tidal Hub has turned the once-quiet structure into a roaring chaos.'}
{3: 'Red light sweeps across the walls, only to be swallowed by deeper shadows. Crimson crystals spread across the surfaces like a plague.'}
{3: 'The next instant, the entire wall explodes into fragments.'}
{3: 'Crystalline threads weave through the debris, pulling rubble and stone into geometric spikes that converge inward like claws.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Lithos twists aside the moment he lands. Paper Crane sweeps out behind him, its blades biting precisely into every incoming shard.'}
{3: 'In the same instant that Paper Crane is pinned down, Arius snatches a crystal from the air.'}
{3: 'The scattered fragments snap back as if pulled by gravity, reforming in his palm into a lance that drives through the smoke.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Green flames shoot out from the gaping hole in the wall. A fist drives straight for Arius' ribs at the same instant."}
{3: "Arius drops the butt of his lance and slices it across the Ascendant's fist, using the momentum to force the entire arm wide."}
{2: 'John Doe', 3: "Dr. Arius... never thought we'd meet like this.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Arius falls back to his previous stance.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'An Ascendant, an agent, and a survivor of the Phylotree of Ousia...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'The Transatlantic Economic Community grows more interesting by the day.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'You stand at the threshold of salvation, yet all you reach for is the conquest of death through Sefirah and the Punishing Virus... Lithos.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'Your grasp of miracles is far too shallow. Even closer to desecration... really.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lithos', 3: "The experiment has already begun. There's no reason to stop it now.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'John Doe offers no response and quietly takes his place beside Lithos.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: "That's the difference between you and me.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Arius', 3: 'I would never surrender myself to the Red Tide... much less call that union evolution.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Beneath the hood, a shadowed smile crosses the man's face."}
{3: 'Arius raises his hand and traces a line through the air.'}
{3: 'Every crimson crystal still hanging in the corridor freezes in place.'}
{3: 'Then the walls begin to move, bending into impossible geometries. The hallway contorts, and the senses that measure space and sight turn inside out.'}
{3: 'He advances toward Arius, but his next step plunges him into the folded corridor.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Arius', 3: 'Perhaps we\'ll meet again... once you\'ve come to "understand" me, Agent.', 5: '18'}
{3: 'Lithos lifts his gaze. At the end of the corridor Arius has twisted, several sets of familiar footsteps are closing in.'}
{3: 'A Construct stops in front of him, long blade lowered at her side.'}
{3: 'Cyan flames and mechanical paper cranes collide with the oncoming blade, metal shrieking in protest.'}
{3: 'The screens flicker as signal disruptions tear through the feed. Static and noise crawl across the edges of the footage.'}
{3: "Lithos' profile flashes briefly on screen. The hooded man confronting him shows only the lower half of his gaze."}
{3: 'On the city surveillance feeds, the streets are already in chaos. Explosives throw up clouds of dust, and figures dart through the smoke.'}
{3: "The Sefirah's energy output is slowly climbing from its lowest point. He just needs a little more time."}
{3: 'After a long silence, he slowly reaches out and picks up the old family photograph from the desk.'}
{3: 'In it, he stands close to his wife, Helentine, and Ophelia.'}
{3: 'Back then, the Atlantic Calamity had not yet happened, and the Punishing Virus had not yet come to the world.'}
{3: 'Those were the days before death and separation, the things too painful to speak of, had arrived.'}
{3: 'His gaze lingers on the photograph, but in the end, not a single word escapes him.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'He turns away. The battle suit Lithos forged for him gleams cold and hard in the dim light.'}
{3: 'The suit awakens to his command. Its mechanical arms unfold with heavy deliberation.'}
{3: 'The first plate seals against his chest. Then the shoulders, the back, the arms, the legs.'}
{3: 'The final piece locks at his collarbone with a heavy, resonant click.'}
{3: 'The chill of the metal seeps through his shirt and into his skin.'}
{2: 'Tavis', 3: 'For all the dead who came before and are yet to come...', 4: '1'}
